Skills.Name: Persuasion
Skills.Description: The art of turning strangers into companions. Owning this tree unlocks recruitment powers.

Powers.Name: Recruit
Powers.Description: Active ability: persuade an adjacent non-hostile creature to join you (d20 + Ego mod vs their level). One companion follows you, fights beside you, and crosses zones with you. 25-turn cooldown.

Powers.Name: Dismiss
Powers.Description: Active ability: release an adjacent companion you recruited. They keep no grudge; the slot frees immediately.
